Can confirm! Minnesota is a very bicycle-friendly place. I don't mind the cold, just be prepared for it. Winter's do make for a bit of a challenge, but not an overwhelming one. I live in a small city just south of the Twin Cities area. The trails are well marked and scenic. On occasion I run into an asphalt trail that could use a bit more TLC from the city since they can be kind of rough and not well-maintained (I have contacted the city about this). I've ridden on the MS-150 once, the TRAM four of five times, the Minnesota Iron-Man (my first century) and have always been impressed about the level of support from the general public. The only times that it can be problematic is on the weekends. Many of the best trails are over-ridden with folks who want to ride at a leisurely pace, and the Lance Armstrong types who want to ride mach 3 with their hair on fire. Bicycle manners and etiquette tend to go out the window at the point. I prefer to just take the streets, or ride on the trails only on weekdays.
